Thanks Naomi. Elena — copying a quick diagnostic from our side so you understand what we suspect.

Symptoms I see in our gateways: the invite link is redirecting through our auth proxy to /sso/redirect which sets a session cookie with SameSite=None; however, on some clients (notably in-app mobile browsers and certain desktop clients with strict cookie partitioning) that cookie is not being stored, causing the downstream Coupa handoff to fail with 403. The vendor screenshot matches the proxy-handled 403 page.

Short-term workarounds to try (one of these should unblock):
- Open the invite link in a full browser (paste into Chrome/Safari address bar) rather than tapping it inside an email client.
- If using mobile, use the "Open in browser" option in the email client rather than the embedded webview.
- We can issue a one-time direct invite link that bypasses the redirect-proxy for 24 hours (see below).

I've attached a tiny log excerpt showing the 403 path (coupa-403-log-excerpt.txt). Engineering: we should track this as PROC-4821 (routing + cookie header). The likely fix is to add a fallback token param to the invite flow so the relaystate isn't lost when SameSite blocks cookie writes.

Ben Carter
Technical Program Manager, Integrations
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 1 Sep 2027 10:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting supplier invite — Coupa 403

Following up with an action plan. Engineering estimates: 48 hours to deploy a small fallback that appends a transient token to the invite URL (server-side) so acceptance can proceed even if the auth cookie is blocked. Steps:
1) Ops will generate a new one-time invite link that uses the transient-token bypass (we can do this manually now).
2) Eng (my team) will deploy the fallback change to the redirect service (RFC + test today, deploy tomorrow).
3) PM/Onboarding will send vendor instructions to open the link in a full browser if they run into an issue.

Naomi — I'll create PROC-4821 in Jira and attach the logs from Ben. In the meantime I ran a manual fresh invite and saved the link to invite-refresh-link.txt — Naomi, please send that to Elena with these simple instructions: copy-paste into Chrome or Safari, avoid in-app email webview.
